portability_recommendations: Do not install the old paper repository as a chronoclone package. Omit src/chronoclone, standalone project/build metadata, package quickstart, API tests, and pip -e .; main scientific notebooks do not require that API.
Preserve all frozen production and native runtime files byte-for-byte; any portable bootstrap or runner belongs outside frozen_runtime and documents exact patched activation logic.

Run the two portable plotting notebooks with cwd=benchmarks/ode_noise. Their calculation code uses cwd plus local results/aggregate and local figures paths; the ../../scripts executor path still works at this depth.

For materially adapted notebooks, print the installed MacBook chronoclone environment absolute path /path/to/ChronoClone/.runtime/chronoclone, kernel chronoclone, versions, and exact command. Current 20260908 notebooks only say see environment.yml and must be updated and executed.

The frozen source_runtime.py enforces historical project-root paths, source hashes, wheel and package/environment provenance. Simply moving it and launching run_chunk.py fails; build a wrapper that activates the included exact 0.1.0 wheel and pinned low-level core, preserves scientific hashes, and demonstrates a small deterministic run before documenting portable full production.

The production run_chunk.py, result schema, and aggregator bind source/runtime hashes. Do not weaken their checks or mix newly generated portable-run shards with the historical 600 shards. A portable rerun must have a separately recorded run identity.
Keep the complete five-method aggregate even though manuscript displays four methods. Cyclone failures are applicability records, not zero accuracy.

Use the existing summary aggregation_metadata.json for compact summary checks. Register the full aggregate independently as a downloadable immutable asset with exact size and SHA-256; replace old pending-asset language only after upload and integrity verification.

Retain original production_source_manifest.sha256 and postprocessing_source_manifest.sha256 from the main benchmark as additional frozen provenance if validating source links across moves; their original paths must be interpreted relative to documented source topology.

The canonical maintained package repository currently has no published source according to parent live API audit. Frozen 0.1.0 benchmark wheel is sufficient for exact historical benchmark implementation but does not imply a new package release.
